record.one_liner: SE Ranking offers an SEO API for keyword research, backlink analysis, domain analysis, site audits, and rank tracking, returning structured JSON via API keys, plus MCP server support for AI assistants.

auth_methods.quote: Just log in to your SE Ranking account, navigate to the API tab under the Settings section, and retrieve your unique API key.

access_test.quote: You can even test it in the free trial account.

access_ship.quote: API access comes with any SE Ranking plan (Core at $129/mo and Growth at $279/mo).

api_type.quote: SE Ranking doesn’t currently offer first-party SDKs and integration is done via the REST API reference and a Postman collection for endpoint testing.

api_breadth.quote: The Data API covers keyword research, backlink analysis, domain performance, SERP data, site audits, and AI visibility research. The Project API lets you manage and automate SEO workflows within the platform

official_mcp.quote: SE Ranking’s MCP server connects SE Ranking’s data directly to AI assistants like Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, and any other client.
